name: SF Infinite Item Use
description: Restores the typed inventory slot addressed by a Consume item action.

changelog: Added a declarative overview page for the Modloader UI.
Added an item ID exclusion list.

excludedItemIds.title: Excluded item IDs

x-ui.label: Excluded item IDs
x-ui.description: Comma-separated or whitespace-separated numeric item IDs that may still be consumed.

settingGroups.label: Restoration
settingGroups.description: Control when consumed items are restored.

components.label: Client runtime
components.text: When enabled, the mod watches completed consume actions.
The mod records the addressed inventory slot before an item is consumed, then restores its count and identity after the server acknowledges the action.
